authorization: User requires direct main integration and no PR; no integration mutations performed during frozen benchmark preparation.

canonical_store.recommendation: Preserve each side immutable objects, observations, trees and snapshots. Union active entry membership and name mapping, then rebuild a new canonical active snapshot through maintained Store API and rebuild disposable SQLite. Do not resolve names/snapshot conflict by taking a whole side.

critical_compatibility_findings.finding: Local concat SEQUENCE_SEMANTICS and upstream owned collections LOCAL_SEMANTICS both claim ink-executable-core-v3.
critical_compatibility_findings.recommendation: Reserve upstream v3 for owned collections and introduce distinct current marker for concat or concat+owned. Reject ambiguous archived concat-v3 wires rather than reinterpret silently; reemit legacy concat source under merged engine when needed, preserving all old frozen-compiler archive bytes. Preserve v1/v2 bytes and do not edit old canonical proof bytes. Root explicitly selected this conservative boundary; AGENTS does not require historical research-format compatibility.

critical_compatibility_findings.finding: Upstream adds Type::Buffer and Type::Map, so local exhaustive matches outside textual merge conflicts can fail compilation.
critical_compatibility_findings.recommendation: Audit local compute_values, semantic, definition_context and target/runtime new matches against Buffer and Map. Preserve upstream owned-collection source semantics, local trusted scalar fastpaths and generic definition-context admission.

critical_compatibility_findings.finding: Upstream observations() independently already implements requested plan filtering before SQL LIMIT and additionally caps candidate plans.
critical_compatibility_findings.recommendation: Keep upstream implementation and both independent regression tests; retain bounded single-snapshot authenticated witness export.

critical_compatibility_findings.finding: DefinitionContext schema binds typed bodies/signatures/callee hashes, not executable module semantics marker.
critical_compatibility_findings.recommendation: Replay generic mathematical roots unchanged after integration. Batch32 scan/zip/map sources use the old ordinary executable domain and definition contexts do not bind executable markers; unchanged typed helper bodies should remain applicable. Recapture/check source contexts only when elaborated typed bodies differ and regenerate source selection packages when wire markers change. Do not claim frozen batch32 timings measure merged engine.

critical_compatibility_findings.finding: Multiple root integration hunks overlap; untracked root source paths have no upstream path collisions.
critical_compatibility_findings.recommendation: Resolve check.rs method inference to combine local concat with upstream collection dispatch; retain concat primitive normalization beside repeat_until/local primitives; preserve definition context require_applicable in action-selection branches and public selection constructor; merge CLI definition-context command with upstream module/action commands; preserve all upstream lib modules.
